description: This is a Perl script for parsing and processing Linux kernel configuration files, supporting operations like loading, combining, diffing, and printing configuration settings.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets a configuration value based on certain conditions.

methods.name: load_config
methods.description: Loads configuration from a file into a hash.

methods.name: config_and
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_add
methods.description: Merges two configuration hashes with optional modifications.

methods.name: config_diff
methods.description: Finds differences between two configuration hashes.

methods.name: config_sub
methods.description: Subtracts one configuration hash from another.

methods.name: parse_expr
methods.description: Parses an expression for configuration operations.
